# Google Play

> Google Play is Android's official digital storefront for apps, games, movies, books, and entertainment content with subscription services.

Google Play serves as the primary app distribution platform for Android devices, offering millions of apps and games alongside movies, TV shows, ebooks, and audiobooks. The platform features discovery tools, ratings, reviews, and subscription services like Google Play Pass for premium content access.

## Key Topics

- Android apps
- Mobile games
- App store

## Core Store Categories

- [Android Apps on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps): Google Play app store for Android apps, games, and digital content
- [Android Apps on Google Play - Games](https://play.google.com/store/games): Google Play games store featuring Android games with ratings and discovery
- [Movies - Movies & TV on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/movies): Google Play movies and TV shows catalog for rental and purchase
- [Books on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/books): Google Play Books ebook, audiobook, manga, and comics digital store

## Subscriptions & Purchases

- [Google Play Pass](https://play.google.com/store/pass/getstarted): Google Play Pass subscription service getting started guide
- [Where to buy gift cards & promotions - Google Play](https://play.google.com/about/giftcards): Google Play gift cards purchasing, redemption, and promotion information
- [Android Apps on Google Play - Redeem](https://play.google.com/redeem): Google Play code redemption page for gift cards and credits
